record.one_liner: Cloud accounting software for small businesses, with invoicing, bank reconciliation, payroll, and reporting.
record.auth_notes: OAuth2 authorization code flow, and PKCE per the MCP README, for multi-org apps. Custom Connections (client credentials for a single org) is a paid, separate option. The OAuth and Custom Connections doc pages returned only titles when fetched. These details come from the MCP README and search results, not from fetched vendor docs.
record.access_notes: The fetched developer.xero.com/pricing page shows a Starter plan with no fee, no payment method, 5 connections, and 1,000 API calls per day per org. Core is A$35/month for 50 connections and needs a payment method. Plus and above need App Certification. Advanced and Enterprise need a security assessment. The Journals endpoint, XPM API, and Bulk Connections are listed as premium and need a security assessment and approval. Custom Connections cost about US$5/month per connection, per a secondary source that I did not verify on Xero's site. I did not confirm whether Starter allows a normal data pull. The page lists its egress as n/a. I also did not confirm whether a demo company is free.
record.blocker: Starter is capped at 5 connections, so a multi-tenant agent toolkit needs a paid plan (Core and up). Plus and above need App Certification. Some endpoints need a security assessment. Pricing has changed recently (tiers from March 2026, per secondary sources).
